## Scope addition from ruling R4-B2 (6820387912 on PR #32497) · 2026-11-12T09:53Z

This card also carries the `_env` cell of #32183's row 17, withdrawn under R4-B2. #32183 holds `_env` at `main`: a name held only by disabled packages answers 409 naming them. This card moves it to row 17's 404 once disabled packages hold no name. That needs the `_env` mark carried to the item face through both transports, and it must not serve a disabled package's pair row.
